name: mobile-ui-audit
description: Evidence harness for the 2026-09-27 mobile UI/UX audit (docs/claude/2026-09-27/mobile-ui-audit). Drives the exported web build of apps/mobile in Chromium. Not shipped, not imported by the app. playwright-core is pinned to the release whose Chromium build is the one installed in the audit container, so nothing downloads a browser.
